note: Re-judged 2026-09-27 by TOOL-4 after the row's citation moved from §8 to §C.1.1, the annex subsection the heading reader now reads; the text and the tagged units are unchanged since QF-2 judged them the same day, so QF-2's reading stands. Forbidden: an IP reachability entry whose identifier collides with a router's system identifier. TestRFC1195ReachabilityEntryIsALeafKeyedByPrefix gives router B a System ID spelling 10.4.0.0/24 and asserts 3 settled router vertices, B at metric 10, C at 15 through B, and one prefix route at 11: a merged identifier space changes the vertex count. TestRFC1195PrefixCannotBridgeDisconnectedRouters asserts a lookalike prefix does not make a disconnected router's 198.51.100.0/24 reachable. Enforced.
